reportedIssues: The discount badge on the pizza restaurant card at the bottom displays '-0%', which is semantically meaningless and visually confusing. A zero-percent discount should not be displayed as a badge at all.

The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is partially clipped without a visible ellipsis on the card image, making it unclear the name is truncated.
The partially visible third card in the horizontal carousel has its image abruptly cut off with no fade or gradient to indicate scrollability, which may confuse users.
